fullText.simplified:
十五、“幸福”的晚饭

    四月底，白素贞发现自己怀孕了。这真是个天大的好消息。许仙从知道的那天起，就高兴得走路都是唱着歌儿的。
    这天，许仙工作了一天回到家，白素贞对他说：“姐姐和姐夫听说我怀孕了，今天送了很多好吃的菜来，你想不想喝点儿酒？我去买点儿好酒，我们好好吃个饭。”
    “好啊。你怀孕了，我去买酒吧，你在家等着。”许仙高兴极了，说完又问：“小青去哪儿了，她不和我们一起吃饭吗？”
    “她去城外玩了，不用管她，过几天就回来。”
    “好吧，她一个人出去，要小心点儿。”
    “放心，小青不是小孩子了。”白素贞笑着说。
    其实小青不是出去玩了，而是去山里修炼了。前几天她在山里发现了一个很美的小湖，她在湖里修炼了几次，发现法力提高了不少。当然，白素贞不能把这些话告诉许仙，她也不能把自己是蛇妖的事告诉许仙。虽然她相信许仙的真心，但她没有信心许仙能接受她是一只妖。
    许仙很快就回来了。他买了两瓶好酒。
    白素贞和许仙两个人坐在房间里，吃着好菜，喝着好酒，真是高兴极了。喝着喝着，白素贞觉得很热，脸也红了。许仙看到了，笑着说：“这雄黄酒太厉害了，夫人，看来你不能喝了。”
    白素贞的心一下子跳到了嘴边：“什么！你说这是什么酒？”
    “雄黄酒。天气变热了，喝雄黄酒对身体好，是好酒呢！”
    白素贞又惊又怕。雄黄不但能让妖变回原形，而且在变回原形的这段时间里，妖是没有法力的。她心里害怕极了，心想：“我刚刚喝了不少，看来很快就要变回原形了，怎么办？不能让他看到！”
    白素贞连忙睡到床上，把被子拉到头上，说：“我喝多了，不舒服，想睡一睡，你去外面走一走吧！”
    许仙却很担心，“夫人，你没事吧？快让我看看！”
    白素贞紧紧拉住被子，说：“没事！你快出去！”
    许仙拉不动被子，就说：“你一定是喝多了，我去给你拿点儿解酒的药来。”
    许仙出去后，白素贞睡在床上，雄黄酒的药力上来了。
    一会儿后，门开了，许仙拿着药碗跑回来了。
    “夫人，药来了！”
    床上的白素贞却一点儿声音也没有，被子却在动。许仙拉开被子，一条又大又粗的白蛇睡在床上。蛇头抬起，一张红色的大嘴正对着许仙。
    药碗掉在了地上，许仙脸色发白，吓得向后倒去，头和身体重重地撞在桌子和地板上。
fullText.traditional:
十五、“幸福”的晚飯

    四月底，白素貞發現自己懷孕了。這真是個天大的好消息。許仙從知道的那天起，就高興得走路都是唱著歌兒的。
    這天，許仙工作了一天回到家，白素貞對他說：“姐姐和姐夫聽說我懷孕了，今天送了很多好吃的菜來，你想不想喝點兒酒？我去買點兒好酒，我們好好吃個飯。”
    “好啊。你懷孕了，我去買酒吧，你在家等著。”許仙高興極了，說完又問：“小青去哪兒了，她不和我們一起吃飯嗎？”
    “她去城外玩了，不用管她，過幾天就回來。”
    “好吧，她一個人出去，要小心點兒。”
    “放心，小青不是小孩子了。”白素貞笑著說。
    其實小青不是出去玩了，而是去山裡修煉了。前幾天她在山裡發現了一個很美的小湖，她在湖裡修煉了幾次，發現法力提高了不少。當然，白素貞不能把這些話告訴許仙，她也不能把自己是蛇妖的事告訴許仙。雖然她相信許仙的真心，但她沒有信心許仙能接受她是一隻妖。
    許仙很快就回來了。他買了兩瓶好酒。
    白素貞和許仙兩個人坐在房間裡，吃著好菜，喝著好酒，真是高興極了。喝著喝著，白素貞覺得很熱，臉也紅了。許仙看到了，笑著說：“這雄黃酒太厲害了，夫人，看來你不能喝了。”
    白素貞的心一下子跳到了嘴邊：“什麼！你說這是什麼酒？”
    “雄黃酒。天氣變熱了，喝雄黃酒對身體好，是好酒呢！”
    白素貞又驚又怕。雄黃不但能讓妖變回原形，而且在變回原形的這段時間裡，妖是沒有法力的。她心裡害怕極了，心想：“我剛剛喝了不少，看來很快就要變回原形了，怎麼辦？不能讓他看到！”
    白素貞連忙睡到床上，把被子拉到頭上，說：“我喝多了，不舒服，想睡一睡，你去外面走一走吧！”
    許仙卻很擔心，“夫人，你沒事吧？快讓我看看！”
    白素貞緊緊拉住被子，說：“沒事！你快出去！”
    許仙拉不動被子，就說：“你一定是喝多了，我去給你拿點兒解酒的藥來。”
    許仙出去後，白素貞睡在床上，雄黃酒的藥力上來了。
    一會兒後，門開了，許仙拿著藥碗跑回來了。
    “夫人，藥來了！”
    床上的白素貞卻一點兒聲音也沒有，被子卻在動。許仙拉開被子，一條又大又粗的白蛇睡在床上。蛇頭抬起，一張紅色的大嘴正對著許仙。
    藥碗掉在了地上，許仙臉色發白，嚇得向後倒去，頭和身體重重地撞在桌子和地板上。

sentences.pinyin: xǔ xiān chū qù hòu bái sù zhēn shuì zài chuáng shang xióng huáng jiǔ de yào lì shàng lái le
sentences.english: Xu Xian left. Bai Suzhen lay on the bed, and the effects of the realgar wine were taking hold.

sentences.simplified: 一会儿后，门开了，许仙拿着药碗跑回来了。
sentences.traditional: 一會兒後，門開了，許仙拿著藥碗跑回來了。
sentences.pinyin: yí huì'r hòu mén kāi le xǔ xiān ná zhe yào wǎn pǎo huí lai le
sentences.english: After a while, the door opened, and Xu Xian came running back with a bowl of medicine.

sentences.simplified: “夫人，药来了！”
sentences.traditional: “夫人，藥來了！”
sentences.pinyin: fū rén yào lái le
sentences.english: “My wife, the medicine is here!”

sentences.simplified: 床上的白素贞却一点儿声音也没有，被子却在动。
sentences.traditional: 床上的白素貞卻一點兒聲音也沒有，被子卻在動。
sentences.pinyin: chuáng shang de bái sù zhēn què yì diǎn'r shēng yīn yě méi yǒu bèi zi què zài dòng
sentences.english: Bai Suzhen, who was on the bed, made no sound at all. However, the blanket was moving.

sentences.simplified: 许仙拉开被子，一条又大又粗的白蛇睡在床上。
sentences.traditional: 許仙拉開被子，一條又大又粗的白蛇睡在床上。
sentences.pinyin: xǔ xiān lā kāi bèi zi yì tiáo yòu dà yòu cū de bái shé shuì zài chuáng shang
sentences.english: Xu Xian pulled back the blanket, and on the bed there lay a large, thick white snake.

sentences.simplified: 蛇头抬起，一张红色的大嘴正对着许仙。
sentences.traditional: 蛇頭抬起，一張紅色的大嘴正對著許仙。
sentences.pinyin: shé tóu tái qǐ yì zhāng hóng sè de dà zuǐ zhèng duì zhe xǔ xiān
sentences.english: The snake raised its head, and a large red mouth was directly facing Xu Xian.

sentences.simplified: 药碗掉在了地上，许仙脸色发白，
sentences.traditional: 藥碗掉在了地上，許仙臉色發白，
sentences.pinyin: yào wǎn diào zài le dì shang xǔ xiān liǎn sè fā bái
sentences.english: The medicine bowl fell to the ground, and Xu Xian’s face turned pale.

sentences.simplified: 吓得向后倒去，头和身体重重地撞在桌子和地板上。
sentences.traditional: 嚇得向後倒去，頭和身體重重地撞在桌子和地板上。
sentences.pinyin: xià de xiàng hòu dǎo qù tóu hé shēn tǐ zhòng zhòng de zhuàng zài zhuō zi hé dì bǎn shang
sentences.english: Frightened, he fell backward, his head and body hitting the table and floor heavily.

sentence_translations: 15. “Happy” Dinner
At the end of April, Bai Suzhen discovered that she was pregnant. This was truly wonderful news.
From the day Xu Xian found out, he was so happy that he walked around singing.
That day, Xu Xian came home after working all day.
Bai Suzhen said to him, “Your older sister and brother-in-law heard that I’m pregnant, so they brought a lot of delicious dishes today.
Do you want to have some wine? I’ll go buy some good wine, and we can have a nice meal together.”
“Sure! You’re pregnant, so I’ll go buy the wine. You stay home and wait.”
Xu Xian was extremely happy. After he said that, he asked again, “Where did Xiaoqing go? Is she not having dinner with us?”
“She went out of town on vacation. Don’t worry about her, she’ll be back in a few days.”
“Alright, she should be careful going out alone.”
“Don’t worry, Xiaoqing isn’t a child anymore,” Bai Suzhen said with a smile.
Actually, Xiaoqing didn’t go on vacation. She went to the mountains to cultivate.
A few days previously, she discovered a beautiful small lake in the mountains.
She cultivated in the lake a few times and found that her magical powers had increased significantly.
Of course, Bai Suzhen couldn’t say these words to Xu Xian, nor could she reveal to him that she was a snake demon.
Although she believed in Xu Xian’s sincerity, ..
.. she did not have confidence that Xu Xian would be accepting of the fact that she was a demon.
Xu Xian returned quickly. He bought two bottles of good wine.
The two of them, Bai Suzhen and Xu Xian, sat in the room, eating delicious food and drinking good wine.
They really were extremely happy.
As she drank, Bai Suzhen felt very hot, and her face also turned red.
Xu Xian saw this and said with a smile, “This realgar wine is too strong, my wife. It seems like you shouldn’t drink any more.”
Bai Suzhen’s heart leapt to her throat all of a sudden, “What! What did you say this wine is?”
“Realgar wine. The weather is getting warmer, and drinking realgar wine is good for the body. It’s a good wine!”
Bai Suzhen was both shocked and scared.
Realgar will not only cause demons to transform back into their true form, ..
.. but during the time the demon transforms back into its true form, the demon will not have magical powers.
She was extremely scared and thought to herself, ..
.. “I drank quite a bit just now. It seems like I’m going to transform back into my true form soon.
What should I do? I can’t let him see it!”
Bai Suzhen hurriedly lay down on the bed, pulled the blanket over her head, and said, ..
.. “I drank too much and don’t feel well. I want to take a nap. You can go for a walk outside!”
Xu Xian was very worried, “My wife, are you okay? Quick, let me see!”
Bai Suzhen held the blanket tightly and said, “It’s fine! You should go out quickly!”
Xu Xian couldn’t pull the blanket, so he said, ..
.. “You must have had too much to drink. I’ll go get you some medicine to counter the alcohol.”
Xu Xian left. Bai Suzhen lay on the bed, and the effects of the realgar wine were taking hold.
After a while, the door opened, and Xu Xian came running back with a bowl of medicine.
“My wife, the medicine is here!”
Bai Suzhen, who was on the bed, made no sound at all. However, the blanket was moving.
Xu Xian pulled back the blanket, and on the bed there lay a large, thick white snake.
The snake raised its head, and a large red mouth was directly facing Xu Xian.
The medicine bowl fell to the ground, and Xu Xian’s face turned pale.
Frightened, he fell backward, his head and body hitting the table and floor heavily.
